## Core Capabilities & Services

1. **3D Web Design & Interactive Web Development**
   - Immersive 3D interactive web experiences using React, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js/WebGL concepts.
   - Ultra-responsive, smooth scroll animations (overlapping card stacks, magnetic buttons, page turns).
   - Speed performance optimized (sub-second load times, mobile-first responsive architecture).

2. **Luxury Branding & Visual Identity**
   - Brand positioning, signature typography, color psychology, and comprehensive brand books.
   - Custom logos, luxury packaging design, and visual brand language for premium brands.

3. **Digital Invitations & Interactive Event Experiences**
   - High-end digital invitations for weddings, baptisms, galas, and celebrations.
   - Dynamic animations, interactive RSVP integration, location maps, music, and WhatsApp sharing.

4. **Digital Brochures & Fashion Studio Portfolios**
   - Interactive editorial lookbooks, haute couture collections, and luxury studio portfolios.
   - Smooth navigation, immersive photo galleries, and direct WhatsApp / commerce integration.

5. **Commercial Photography & Creative Media Showcases**
   - High-impact visual platforms for professional studios, fashion houses, and video production firms.
   - Fullscreen showcases, lightbox galleries, and video player integration.

6. **Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & AI Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**
   - Technical SEO, JSON-LD structured schema, fast Core Web Vitals.
   - Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) ensuring top ranking and accurate citation on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
